title: Changing location opens that location's default page and resets Assigned to me
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Assigned to me enabled; user has a second location.
custom_steps:
1. Enable Assigned to me on Work Orders.
  2. Switch to another location.
  3. Observe which page opens.
  4. Observe the Assigned to me state.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Changing location opens that location's existing default page.
  • "Assigned to me" turns itself off when you change location, exactly as it does today.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Story 1 Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S1-E2, S1-E3 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-E2: “Changing location opens that location’s existing default page.”
  • S1-E3: “Assigned to me resets on location change, as it does today.”
